criteria.reason: The exercise menu shows “Skip Exercise” while logging a workout.
A confirmation prompt appears before skip or resume is applied.
Skipping sends every set with status "skipped", which the server persists.
The card displays a “Skipped” label when the exercise is skipped.
The menu offers resume during the workout, but unskip leaves blank sets marked skipped, so a reload can restore the skipped state.
The existing set logging endpoint accepts and returns explicit skipped statuses.
A new server test covers skip persistence, but there is no test for unskip.
No new client test for the skip UI appears in the diff.
The harness reports all server and client tests passing.
The added UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
